Intense Geomagnetic Storm Events

  
NOTE: This is a list of intense geomagnetic storms (Dst ≤ -100 nT) and their solar sources. The storms
were identified in the geomagnetic field data provided by the WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto
The list starts from 1996 when the SOHO mission started routinely observing the Sun.

References
Gopalswamy, N., Akiyama, S., Yashiro, S., Mäkelä, P., and Xie, H. (2025), 
   Annotated Catalog of Intense Geomagnetic Storms Including Their Solar and Interplanetary Causes, 
   Journal of Astrophysics and Astronomy, 46, 78. [DOI:10.1007/s12036-025-10091-7]
